title: Was there again last night.
content: This time there were these secret door shoots that led to lower levels in one of the movie theatres. Ive noticed that its a pattern in my mall world. Areas where you can open a door in the wall or the floor and shoot into a different level. Ive now experienced this 3 times. Like secret small body size doors in walls , floors etc , almost like those warp tubes in the original mario brothers but hidden.
